title: AcDs peer, specification-discrepancy, and parser-safety reconciliation
mode: Official ODA specification review, current open-source primary-source comparison, and local source/test crosswalk
scope: Reconcile the DWG AcDsPrototype_1b data-start/alignment contract with current peer parser and writer evidence.
Audit current peer-reported AcDs identity/index and parser-safety failure shapes against existing local owners.
Distinguish DXF syntax/raw ACIS preservation from B-rep and native 3D semantics.

method.limitations: Peer corpus sizes and reported fixes are contributor statements, not independently reproduced here. The ACadSharp claim that the ODA last-record maximum-size formula is erroneous is unresolved: no ODA erratum or independently rerun minimal producer file was inspected. Local source guards were reviewed statically; no new fuzzing or dynamic peer validation was run.

sources.name: Official ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.observed: Section 24.2.1 defines system/object alignment offsets in 16-byte units from the segment start. Section 24.2.2.3 places the data-start marker after data-record headers, defines record starts using the marker plus local offsets, and states the maximum-record-size calculation for the final record.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Authoritative for the cited DWG byte-layout contract. A public peer discussion disputes part of the final-record coordinate formula, but that does not itself establish an erratum.

sources.name: ACadSharp merged Prototype1b reader PR #1154 and issue #1152
sources.observed: The merged reader models the whole DataStorage section and exposes handle/schema data; discussion records a data-start alignment failure, stale segment-index bounds case, and later contributor-reported per-handle payload matches after revisions.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Implementation and contributor corpus reports for one peer; not independently reproduced, normative, or a blanket producer-profile guarantee.

sources.name: ACadSharp Blob01 follow-up #1156
sources.observed: The Blob01 reassembly proposal was closed because the later whole-section reader offered a generic resolver; discussion reports successful resolution of large multi-page records through that accessor.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer implementation lineage and reported validation only; the PR is not a separate deployed parser vote.

sources.name: ACadSharp modeler writer PR #1150
sources.observed: The proposal remains unmerged. Its contributor reports finding that a search-segment per-handle entry must use the rank in sorted-handle order rather than directory order; subsequent discussion identifies rebasing and schema-refactor/readback issues.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Unmerged writer branch and contributor-reported test shape; not a released writer result or an independent application check.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS and fuzz harness
sources.observed: The release documents distinct decompression-size, page-offset, integer-overflow, 3DSOLID block-size, non-finite-angle loop, pointer-lifetime, and progress/OOM hardening fixes, plus separate fuzz routes and crash replay.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Current peer security/robustness evidence; not a local defect report or semantic support proof.

sources.name: ezdxf repository and documentation
sources.observed: The project documents ASCII/Binary DXF read/write and third-party tag retention; ACIS data creation depends on an external library, the drawing add-on does not render ACIS, and its DWG option is via ODA File Converter.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Published feature and limitation boundaries; not a libdxfrw peer runtime result, 3D semantic oracle, or independent DWG parser route.

sources.name: Local DataStorage, modeler, and MLINE source/tests
sources.observed: The local DataStorage parser uses checked offset arithmetic and bounds against the segment's object-data anchor; generated local cases cover record-count/alignment and Blob01 shapes. The local SAT-v1 modeler reader bounds signed block sizes and aggregate bytes. MLINESTYLE output rejects non-finite angles with ASCII/Binary no-publication controls.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Static source and existing generated test-owner review; not new dynamic validation or proof of complete parser hardening.

plan_impact.data_storage_formula: Keep ODA v5.4.1 authoritative and mark the ACadSharp-reported last-record formula discrepancy unresolved. On future edits, document each coordinate origin explicitly and require exact-profile independent evidence before adopting an erratum interpretation.
plan_impact.peer_reader: Treat ACadSharp #1154 as a current merged structural/raw-payload route, with contributor-reported corpus evidence only. Keep full-section parse, reachable record identity, entity association, exact payload, and B-rep semantics as separate evidence rows.
plan_impact.peer_writer: Keep #1150 unmerged and non-authoritative. Preserve existing locally generated permuted-handle/search-index tests; do not create a writer task because local raw-section replay does not synthesize a schema-aware search index.
plan_impact.hardening: Map LibreDWG's release-note bug classes to existing local checked arithmetic, bounded allocations/progress, SAT block parsing, and non-finite writer-refusal owners. Keep fuzz/sanitizer campaigns at scheduled composed gates; no new per-slice campaign.
plan_impact.ezdxf: Keep DXF tag retention, raw ACIS carrier, 3D rendering, and DWG conversion route separate; do not count ezdxf rendering as B-rep semantics or ODA-mediated DWG conversion as an independent parser.
plan_impact.implementation_speed: Reuse current focused selectors and tests; no new dependency, fixture, CTest, full-suite run, peer runtime, support promotion, or queue/cadence change. Continue the dependency-ready local implementation queue.

repository_state: Shared worktree is broadly dirty. This research receipt and plan update are uncommitted; no unrelated files were staged or committed.
